svg.title: coderprint: 703k lines of code in use, of 1.5M written, all time
svg.desc: 703,405 lines of code in use (470,909 in production, 232,496 in tests), of 1,509,385 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 3,772 commits across all branches, 68 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 13 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 1.4M lines of code. The bars end on 30OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 61%, Lean 18%, Python 12%, TypeScript 5%, JavaScript 3%, other languages 1%. Of what was written, 47% is kept.
